## Deconvolving cell-type proportions

Loading the AMP-PD bulk RNA-seq dataset (2022_v3 release_1115) for cell-type deconvolution analysis.

```{r}
txn_v3_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/input/",
    "amp-pd-transcriptomics_2022_v3release_1115"
)
txn_v4_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/input/",
    "amp-pd-transcriptomics_2023_v4release_1027"
)

genes_df_v3 <- data.table::fread(glue("{txn_v3_dir}/matrix.genes.tsv"))
genes_df_v4 <- data.table::fread(glue("{txn_v4_dir}/matrix.genes.tsv"))

genes_df <- merge(genes_df_v3, genes_df_v4, by = "Geneid", all = TRUE) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

dim(genes_df)
knitr::kable(genes_df[1:5, 1:5])

```

Converting ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols.


```{r}
hub <- AnnotationHub()
edb <- hub[["AH73881"]] # EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86

orgs <- subset(hub, hub$rdataclass == "OrgDb")
orgdb <- AnnotationHub::query(orgs, "Homo sapiens")[[1]]
orgdb
columns(orgdb)

k <- genes_df$Geneid %>% str_before_first(., "\\.")
gene_id_map <- mapIds(orgdb,
    keys = k,
    column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "asNA"
)

# Convert the named vector to a data frame
gene_id_map_df <- data.frame(
    Geneid = genes_df$Geneid,
    ENSEMBL = names(gene_id_map),
    SYMBOL = unname(gene_id_map),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
    glimpse()

# Display the first few rows
head(gene_id_map_df)

gene_id_map_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
    janitor::get_dupes(SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(SYMBOL)) %>%
    head()

gene_mat <- gene_id_map_df %>%
    left_join(genes_df) %>%
    glimpse()

# samples are normalized by TPM (column sums are roughly 1 million)
gene_mat[, 4:10] %>% colSums()
gene_mat[1:5, 1:5]

gene_mat_df <- gene_mat %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(Geneid, ENSEMBL)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL") %>%
    as.matrix()

# This is the TPM normalized gene expression matrix excluding all non-coding and lnc RNAs
gene_mat_df[1:5, 1:5]
saveRDS(gene_mat_df, file = glue(
    "{deconv_outdir}/",
    "formatted_gene_matrix_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
))

```


Based on the benchmark analysis of the immunedeconv package, we will use EPIC, ABIS, and xCell for cell-type deconvolution. These methods appear to preform well on B-cell, CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell deconvolution.

```{r}
    "{deconv_outdir}/",

decon_list <- list()
decon_list[["epic"]] <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(gene_mat_df, "epic", tumor = FALSE)
decon_list[["abis"]] <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(gene_mat_df, "abis", tumor = FALSE)

    "{deconv_outdir}/",
    "deconvoluted_cell_types_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
))
```

Visualizing ABIS deconvolution results.

```{r}
decon_list <- readRDS(glue(
    "{deconv_outdir}/",
    "deconvoluted_cell_types_2025-06-23.rds"
))

decon_list[["abis"]]$cell_type %>% unique()
decon_df_long_abis <- decon_list[["abis"]] %>% 
    pivot_longer(!cell_type, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "value") %>% 
    glimpse()

abis_mat <- decon_list[["abis"]] %>% column_to_rownames(var = "cell_type") %>% t()
sid_order_abis <- seriate_matrix_rows(abis_mat, seriate_method = "HC_average")
# min(decon_df_long$value)

p_abis <- decon_df_long_abis %>% 
    mutate(value = ifelse(value < 0, 0, value)) %>% 
    mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = sid_order_abis)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = value, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
    # scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", fill = "ABIS Cell Type") +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )

ggsave(
    filename = glue(
        "{deconv_fig_dir}/",
        "abis_cell_type_distribution_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    plot = p_abis,
    width = 14,
    height = 7
)

```

Summing T-cell proportions across all methods and comparing distributions.

```{r}
summarize_tcell_props <- function(decon_df_long, decon_method, cell_group = "T cell") {
    decon_df_long %>%
        mutate(value = case_when(
            value < 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ value
        )) %>% 
        filter(grepl(cell_group, cell_type)) %>%
        group_by(sample_id) %>%
        summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(method = decon_method) %>%
        glimpse()
}


names(decon_list)
t_cell_distr <- list()
for (decon_method in names(decon_list)) {
    t_cell_distr[[decon_method]] <- decon_list[[decon_method]] %>%
        map_result_to_celltypes(c("T cell"), decon_method)
}
# names(t_cell_distr)

t_cell_distr_epic <- t_cell_distr[["epic"]] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(method = "epic")
t_cell_distr_xcell <- t_cell_distr[["xcell"]] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(method = "xcell")

tcell_props_df <- bind_rows(
    summarize_tcell_props(decon_df_long_abis, "abis") %>%
        mutate(value = value / 100),
    t_cell_distr_epic,
    t_cell_distr_xcell
    # Not accurate for EPIC and xCell due to hierarchical cell type classification
    # summarize_tcell_props(decon_df_long_epic, "epic"),
    # summarize_tcell_props(decon_df_long_xcell, "xcell")
) %>%
    glimpse()

p_tcell_props_dist <- tcell_props_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = method, y = value)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = sample_id), alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.4) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "T-cell Proportion")

ggsave(
    filename = glue(
        "{deconv_fig_dir}/",
        "tcell_props_distribution_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    plot = p_tcell_props_dist,
    width = 5,
    height = 5
)
```

Aggregating across cell types of interest and across methods to store with metadata.

```{r}
cois <- c("B cell", "T cell", "T cell CD4+", "T cell CD8+")

tmp_xcell <- decon_list[["xcell"]] %>%
  map_result_to_celltypes(cois, "xcell") %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type") %>%
  gather("sample", "estimate", -cell_type) %>%
  mutate(method = "xCell")

tmp_epic <- decon_list[["epic"]] %>%
  map_result_to_celltypes(cois, "epic") %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type") %>%
  gather("sample", "estimate", -cell_type) %>%
  mutate(method = "EPIC")

tmp_abis <- cois %>% purrr::map(
    ~ summarize_tcell_props(decon_df_long_abis, "abis", .x) %>% 
    mutate(cell_type = .x)
    ) %>% 
    bind_rows() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(estimate = value, sample = sample_id) %>% 
    glimpse()

tmp_total <- bind_rows(tmp_xcell, tmp_epic, tmp_abis) %>%
  glimpse()

deconv_meta <- tmp_total %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type_method = glue("{method} {cell_type}")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id = sample, cell_type_method, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type_method, values_from = estimate) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::glimpse()

library(GGally)
p_method_cor <- ggpairs(deconv_meta, columns = c(3, 7, 11)) 
ggsave(
    filename = glue(
        "{deconv_fig_dir}/",
        "tcell_props_corr_mat_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    plot = p_method_cor,
    width = 7,
    height = 6
)

saveRDS(
    deconv_meta,
    file = glue(
        "{deconv_outdir}/",
        "deconvoluted_cell_types_metadata_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

```


## Quantifying inflammation gene programs 

```{r}
# loading gene expression matrix
gene_mat_df <- readRDS(glue(
    "{deconv_outdir}/",
    "formatted_gene_matrix_2025-06-23.rds"
))

# log-transform gene exp.
log_tpm <- log2(gene_mat_df + 0.1)

# prepping relavent metadata
cohort_meta <- read.csv(glue("{v4_metapath}/amp_pd_participants.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, study) %>% 
  glimpse()

meta <- bind_rows(
    read_csv(glue("{v4_1027_dir}/rnaseq_WB-RWTS-VHBS_sample_inventory.csv")),
    read_csv(glue("{v4_1027_dir}/rnaseq_WB-RWTS_sample_inventory.csv"))) %>% 
    dplyr::select(sample_id, participant_id) %>% 
    left_join(cohort_meta) %>% 
    filter(sample_id %in% colnames(log_tpm)) %>% 
    glimpse()

# reordering gene exp. matrix to match metadata
log_tpm <- log_tpm[ , meta$sample_id ] # reorder
clean_expr <- limma::removeBatchEffect(log_tpm, batch = meta$study)

log_tpm[1:5, 1:5]
clean_expr[1:5, 1:5]

# bind_cols(
#     "log_tpm" = log_tpm["IL6",], 
#     "batch_corrected" = clean_expr["IL6",]) %>% 
#     ggplot(aes(x = log_tpm, y = batch_corrected)) +
#     geom_point() +
#     theme_bw() +
#     labs(x = "log(TPM + 0.1)", y = "batch-corrected log(TPM + 0.1)")


#  helper to fetch + z-score
score_set <- function(category, subcat = NULL, set_name, method = "ssgsea") {
  genes <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
                   category = category,
                   subcategory = subcat) %>% 
           filter(gs_name == set_name) %>% 
           pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
  gsva(clean_expr, list(tmp = genes), method = method)[1, ] %>%        # vector
    scale() %>% as.numeric()                                           # z-score
}

# Compute scores
scores <- tibble(
  sample_id = colnames(clean_expr),
  GEP_GO_IFN         = score_set("C5", "BP",  "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_TYPE_I_INTERFERON"),
  GEP_HALLMARK_INF   = score_set("H",  NULL,  "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE"),
  GEP_TH17_SIG       = score_set("C7",  NULL, "GSE14308_TH17_VS_NAIVE_CD4_TCELL_UP"),
  GEP_REACTOME_CYTO  = score_set("C2", "CP:REACTOME", "REACTOME_CYTOKINE_SIGNALING_IN_IMMUNE_SYSTEM")
)

saveRDS(scores,
    glue("{deconv_outdir}/",
        "inflammation_gene_program_scores_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

```
